project.description: Target project name (required in multiproject workspaces)

installSkill.description: Generate the AI agent skill (.agents/skills/ngx-iconify-stack) in the target project
installSkill.x-prompt: Generate the AI agent skill (SKILL.md) for ngx-iconify-stack in the project?

mode.description: How icons are resolved at runtime. autohost (default): scans templates, generates an offline icon subset (SSR-safe, self-hosted), adds @iconify-json/* dependencies and wires the prebuild script. cdn: uses the Iconify CDN only — no subset file, no prebuild wiring, provider is provideIconify() without offlineCollections.
mode.x-prompt: How should icons be loaded at runtime? (autohost: offline subset + prebuild wiring | cdn: Iconify CDN only)
